verses.original: וַיְהִ֖י בִּימֵ֣י אֲחַשְׁוֵר֑וֹשׁ ה֣וּא אֲחַשְׁוֵר֗וֹשׁ הַמֹּלֵךְ֙ מֵהֹ֣דּוּ וְעַד־ כּ֔וּשׁ שֶׁ֛בַע וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּמֵאָ֖ה מְדִינָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bî·mê ’ă·ḥaš·wê·rō·wōš hū ’ă·ḥaš·wê·rō·wōš ham·mō·lêḵ mê·hōd·dū wə·‘aḏ- kūš še·ḇa‘ wə·‘eś·rîm ū·mê·’āh mə·ḏî·nāh
verses.literal: This is what happened in the days of Xerxes . . . . . . who reigned over 127 . . . . . . provinces from India to Cush
verses.literalPt: Sucedeu, nos dias de Assuero (este é o Assuero que reinou desde a Índia até a Etiópia, sobre cento e vinte e sete províncias.),

verses.original: בַּיָּמִ֖ים הָהֵ֑ם כְּשֶׁ֣בֶת׀ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֗וֹשׁ עַ֚ל כִּסֵּ֣א מַלְכוּת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּשׁוּשַׁ֥ן הַבִּירָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yā·mîm hā·hêm kə·še·ḇeṯ ham·me·leḵ ’ă·ḥaš·wê·rō·wōš ‘al kis·sê mal·ḵū·ṯōw ’ă·šer bə·šū·šan hab·bî·rāh
verses.literal: In those days King Xerxes sat on his royal throne in the citadel of Susa
verses.literalPt: que, estando o rei Assuero sentado no trono do seu reino, no castelo de Susã,

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֤ת שָׁלוֹשׁ֙ לְמָלְכ֔וֹ עָשָׂ֣ה מִשְׁתֶּ֔ה לְכָל־ שָׂרָ֖יו וַעֲבָדָ֑יו חֵ֣יל׀ פָּרַ֣ס וּמָדַ֗י הַֽפַּרְתְּמִ֛ים וְשָׂרֵ֥י הַמְּדִינ֖וֹת לְפָנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: biš·naṯ šā·lō·wōš lə·mā·lə·ḵōw ‘ā·śāh miš·teh lə·ḵāl śā·rāw wa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw ḥêl pā·ras ū·mā·ḏay hap·par·tə·mîm wə·śā·rê ham·mə·ḏî·nō·wṯ lə·p̄ā·nāw
verses.literal: In the third year of his reign Xerxes held a feast for all his officials and servants The military leaders of Persia and Media were there along with the nobles and princes of the provinces
verses.literalPt: ao terceiro ano do seu reinado, deu um banquete a todos os seus príncipes e seus servos, em que estava representado o poder da Pérsia e da Média nas pessoas dos nobres e príncipes das províncias.

verses.original: בְּהַרְאֹת֗וֹ אֶת־ עֹ֙שֶׁר֙ כְּב֣וֹד מַלְכוּת֔וֹ וְאֶ֨ת־ יְקָ֔ר תִּפְאֶ֖רֶת גְּדוּלָּת֑וֹ יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים שְׁמוֹנִ֥ים וּמְאַ֖ת יֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·har·’ō·ṯōw ’eṯ- ‘ō·šer kə·ḇō·wḏ mal·ḵū·ṯōw wə·’eṯ- yə·qār tip̄·’e·reṯ gə·ḏūl·lā·ṯōw yā·mîm rab·bîm šə·mō·w·nîm ū·mə·’aṯ yō·wm
verses.literal: And for a full 180 . . . . . . days he displayed the glorious riches of his kingdom and the magnificent splendor of his greatness
verses.literalPt: Nessa ocasião, mostrou as riquezas do seu reino glorioso e a grandeza da sua excelente majestade durante muitos dias, durante cento e oitenta dias.

verses.original: וּבִמְל֣וֹאת׀ הַיָּמִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה עָשָׂ֣ה הַמֶּ֡לֶךְ לְכָל־ הָעָ֣ם הַנִּמְצְאִים֩ בְּשׁוּשַׁ֨ן הַבִּירָ֜ה לְמִגָּ֧דוֹל וְעַד־ קָטָ֛ן מִשְׁתֶּ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים בַּחֲצַ֕ר גִּנַּ֥ת בִּיתַ֖ן הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇim·lō·wṯ hay·yā·mîm hā·’êl·leh ‘ā·śāh ham·me·leḵ lə·ḵāl hā·‘ām han·nim·ṣə·’îm bə·šū·šan hab·bî·rāh lə·mig·gā·ḏō·wl wə·‘aḏ- qā·ṭān miš·teh šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm ba·ḥă·ṣar gin·naṯ bî·ṯan ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: At the end of this time in the garden court of the royal palace the king held a seven-day . . . feast for all the people in the citadel of Susa from the least to the greatest
verses.literalPt: Acabados que foram esses dias, deu o rei um banquete a todo o povo que se achava no castelo de Susã, tanto a grandes como a pequenos, por sete dias, no átrio do jardim do palácio do rei;

verses.original: ח֣וּר׀ כַּרְפַּ֣ס וּתְכֵ֗לֶת אָחוּז֙ בְּחַבְלֵי־ ב֣וּץ וְאַרְגָּמָ֔ן עַל־ גְּלִ֥ילֵי כֶ֖סֶף וְעַמּ֣וּדֵי שֵׁ֑שׁ מִטּ֣וֹת׀ זָהָ֣ב וָכֶ֗סֶף עַ֛ל רִֽצְפַ֥ת בַּהַט־ וָשֵׁ֖שׁ וְדַ֥ר וְסֹחָֽרֶת׃
verses.transliteration: ḥūr kar·pas ū·ṯə·ḵê·leṯ ’ā·ḥūz bə·ḥaḇ·lê- ḇūṣ wə·’ar·gā·mān ‘al- gə·lî·lê ḵe·sep̄ wə·‘am·mū·ḏê šêš miṭ·ṭō·wṯ zā·hāḇ wā·ḵe·sep̄ ‘al riṣ·p̄aṯ ba·haṭ- wā·šêš wə·ḏar wə·sō·ḥā·reṯ
verses.literal: Hangings of white and blue linen were fastened with cords of fine white and purple material to silver rings on the marble pillars Gold and silver couches were arranged on a mosaic pavement of porphyry marble mother-of-pearl and other costly stones
verses.literalPt: e havia toldos de pano branco, verde e azul, atados com cordões de linho fino e de púrpura a argolas de prata e a colunas de mármore. Os leitos eram de ouro e de prata, sobre um pavimento de pórfiro, e de mármore, e de alabastro, e de pedras de cor escura.

verses.original: וְהַשְׁקוֹת֙ בִּכְלֵ֣י זָהָ֔ב וְכֵלִ֖ים מִכֵּלִ֣ים שׁוֹנִ֑ים וְיֵ֥ין מַלְכ֛וּת רָ֖ב כְּיַ֥ד הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·haš·qō·wṯ biḵ·lê zā·hāḇ wə·ḵê·lîm mik·kê·lîm šō·w·nîm wə·yên mal·ḵūṯ rāḇ kə·yaḏ ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: Beverages were served in an array of goblets of gold each . . . with a different design and the royal wine flowed freely according to the king’s bounty
verses.literalPt: Dava-se-lhes de beber em vasos de ouro, diferentes uns dos outros, e havia vinho real em abundância, segundo a liberalidade do rei.

verses.original: וְהַשְּׁתִיָּ֥ה כַדָּ֖ת אֵ֣ין אֹנֵ֑ס כִּי־ כֵ֣ן׀ יִסַּ֣ד הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ עַ֚ל כָּל־ רַ֣ב בֵּית֔וֹ לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת כִּרְצ֥וֹן אִישׁ־ וָאִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·haš·šə·ṯî·yāh ḵad·dāṯ ’ên ’ō·nês kî- ḵên yis·saḏ ham·me·leḵ ‘al kāl- raḇ bê·ṯōw la·‘ă·śō·wṯ kir·ṣō·wn ’îš- wā·’îš
verses.literal: By order of the king no limit was placed on the drinking . . . and every official of his household was to serve each man whatever he desired
verses.literalPt: Bebiam como estava prescrito, sem constrangimento, porque o rei tinha ordenado a todos os oficiais da sua casa que fizessem conforme cada um queria.

verses.original: גַּ֚ם וַשְׁתִּ֣י הַמַּלְכָּ֔ה עָשְׂתָ֖ה מִשְׁתֵּ֣ה נָשִׁ֑ים בֵּ֚ית הַמַּלְכ֔וּת אֲשֶׁ֖ר לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרֽוֹשׁ׃ס
verses.transliteration: gam waš·tî ham·mal·kāh ‘ā·śə·ṯāh miš·têh nā·šîm bêṯ ham·mal·ḵūṯ ’ă·šer lam·me·leḵ ’ă·ḥaš·wê·rō·wōš
verses.literal: Queen Vashti also gave a banquet for the women in the royal palace of King Xerxes
verses.literalPt: A rainha Vasti também deu um banquete às mulheres na casa real do rei Assuero.

verses.original: בַּיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י כְּט֥וֹב לֵב־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בַּיָּ֑יִן אָמַ֡ר לִ֠מְהוּמָן בִּזְּתָ֨א חַרְבוֹנָ֜א בִּגְתָ֤א וַאֲבַגְתָא֙ זֵתַ֣ר וְכַרְכַּ֔ס שִׁבְעַת֙ הַסָּ֣רִיסִ֔ים הַמְשָׁ֣רְתִ֔ים אֶת־ פְּנֵ֖י הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î kə·ṭō·wḇ lêḇ- ham·me·leḵ bay·yā·yin ’ā·mar lim·hū·mān biz·zə·ṯā ḥar·ḇō·w·nā biḡ·ṯā wa·’ă·ḇaḡ·ṯā zê·ṯar wə·ḵar·kas šiḇ·‘aṯ has·sā·rî·sîm ham·šā·rə·ṯîm ’eṯ- pə·nê ham·me·leḵ ’ă·ḥaš·wê·rō·wōš
verses.literal: On the seventh day when the king’s heart was merry with wine he ordered the seven eunuchs who served . . . . . . . . . him Mehuman Biztha Harbona Bigtha Abagtha Zethar and Carkas
verses.literalPt: Ao sétimo dia, quando o coração do rei estava alegre de vinho, mandou a Meumã, Bizta, Harbona, Bigtá, Abagta, Zetar e Carcas, sete eunucos que ministravam na presença do rei Assuero,

verses.original: לְ֠הָבִיא אֶת־ וַשְׁתִּ֧י הַמַּלְכָּ֛ה לִפְנֵ֥י הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בְּכֶ֣תֶר מַלְכ֑וּת לְהַרְא֨וֹת הָֽעַמִּ֤ים וְהַשָּׂרִים֙ אֶת־ יָפְיָ֔הּ כִּֽי־ טוֹבַ֥ת מַרְאֶ֖ה הִֽיא׃
verses.transliteration: lə·hā·ḇî ’eṯ- waš·tî ham·mal·kāh lip̄·nê ham·me·leḵ bə·ḵe·ṯer mal·ḵūṯ lə·har·’ō·wṯ hā·‘am·mîm wə·haś·śā·rîm ’eṯ- yā·p̄ə·yāh kî- ṭō·w·ḇaṯ mar·’eh hî
verses.literal: to bring Queen Vashti before him wearing her royal crown to display her beauty to the people and officials For she was beautiful to behold
verses.literalPt: que introduzissem à presença do rei a rainha Vasti, para mostrar aos povos e aos príncipes a formosura dela, pois era em extremo formosa.

verses.original: וַתְּמָאֵ֞ן הַמַּלְכָּ֣ה וַשְׁתִּ֗י לָבוֹא֙ בִּדְבַ֣ר הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּיַ֣ד הַסָּרִיסִ֑ים וַיִּקְצֹ֤ף הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ מְאֹ֔ד וַחֲמָת֖וֹ בָּעֲרָ֥ה בֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·mā·’ên ham·mal·kāh waš·tî lā·ḇō·w biḏ·ḇar ham·me·leḵ ’ă·šer bə·yaḏ has·sā·rî·sîm way·yiq·ṣōp̄ ham·me·leḵ mə·’ōḏ wa·ḥă·mā·ṯōw bā·‘ă·rāh ḇōw
verses.literal: Queen Vashti, however refused to come at the king’s command brought by his eunuchs And the king became furious . . . and his anger burned within him
verses.literalPt: A rainha Vasti, porém, recusou vir, como o rei lhe tinha ordenado por meio dos eunucos; portanto, o rei muito se enfureceu e se inflamou de ira.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ לַחֲכָמִ֖ים יֹדְעֵ֣י הָֽעִתִּ֑ים כִּי־ כֵן֙ דְּבַ֣ר הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ לִפְנֵ֕י כָּל־ יֹדְעֵ֖י דָּ֥ת וָדִֽין׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ham·me·leḵ la·ḥă·ḵā·mîm yō·ḏə·‘ê hā·‘it·tîm kî- ḵên də·ḇar ham·me·leḵ lip̄·nê kāl- yō·ḏə·‘ê dāṯ wā·ḏîn
verses.literal: Then the king consulted the wise men who knew the times for it was customary for him to confer with . . . the experts in law and justice
verses.literalPt: Então, disse o rei aos sábios, conhecedores do tempo (pois assim se tratava o procedimento do rei perante todos os que sabiam as leis e os costumes;

verses.original: וְהַקָּרֹ֣ב אֵלָ֗יו כַּרְשְׁנָ֤א שֵׁתָר֙ אַדְמָ֣תָא תַרְשִׁ֔ישׁ מֶ֥רֶס מַרְסְנָ֖א מְמוּכָ֑ן שִׁבְעַ֞ת שָׂרֵ֣י׀ פָּרַ֣ס וּמָדַ֗י רֹאֵי֙ פְּנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ הַיֹּשְׁבִ֥ים רִאשֹׁנָ֖ה בַּמַּלְכֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·haq·qā·rōḇ ʾē·lå̄w kar·šə·nā šê·ṯār ’aḏ·mā·ṯā ṯar·šîš me·res mar·sə·nā mə·mū·ḵān šiḇ·‘aṯ śā·rê pā·ras ū·mā·ḏay rō·’ê pə·nê ham·me·leḵ hay·yō·šə·ḇîm ri·šō·nāh bam·mal·ḵūṯ
verses.literal: His closest advisors were Carshena Shethar Admatha Tarshish Meres Marsena and Memucan the seven princes of Persia and Media who had personal access to . . . the king and ranked highest in the kingdom
verses.literalPt: e os mais chegados a ele eram: Carsena, Setar, Adamata, Társis, Meres, Marsena e Memucã, os quais eram os sete príncipes da Pérsia e da Média, que viam o rosto do rei e se assentavam mais perto dele no reino.):

verses.original: כְּדָת֙ מַֽה־ לַּעֲשׂ֔וֹת בַּמַּלְכָּ֖ה וַשְׁתִּ֑י עַ֣ל׀ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ עָשְׂתָ֗ה אֶֽת־ מַאֲמַר֙ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֔וֹשׁ בְּיַ֖ד הַסָּרִיסִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: kə·ḏāṯ mah- la·‘ă·śō·wṯ bam·mal·kāh waš·tî ‘al ’ă·šer lō- ‘ā·śə·ṯāh ’eṯ- ma·’ă·mar ham·me·leḵ ’ă·ḥaš·wê·rō·wōš bə·yaḏ has·sā·rî·sîm
verses.literal: According to law he asked, “what should be done with Queen Vashti since she refused to obey . . . the command of King Xerxes delivered by the eunuchs
verses.literalPt: Que havemos de fazer, segundo a lei, à rainha Vasti, por não ter obedecido à ordem que o rei Assuero tinha enviado por meio dos eunucos?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מוּמְכָן לִפְנֵ֤י הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ וְהַשָּׂרִ֔ים לֹ֤א עַל־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ לְבַדּ֔וֹ עָוְתָ֖ה וַשְׁתִּ֣י הַמַּלְכָּ֑ה כִּ֤י עַל־ כָּל־ הַשָּׂרִים֙ וְעַל־ כָּל־ הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֕ר בְּכָל־ מְדִינ֖וֹת הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mū·mə·ḵå̄n lip̄·nê ham·me·leḵ wə·haś·śā·rîm lō ‘al- ham·me·leḵ lə·ḇad·dōw ‘ā·wə·ṯāh waš·tî ham·mal·kāh kî ‘al- kāl- haś·śā·rîm wə·‘al- kāl- hā·‘am·mîm ’ă·šer bə·ḵāl mə·ḏî·nō·wṯ ham·me·leḵ ’ă·ḥaš·wê·rō·wōš
verses.literal: And in the presence of the king and his princes Memucan replied Queen Vashti has wronged not . . . only the king but . . . all the princes . . . and the peoples - in all the provinces of King Xerxes
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Memucã, na presença do rei e dos príncipes: A rainha Vasti não somente ofendeu ao rei, mas também a todos os príncipes e a todos os povos que há em todas as províncias do rei Assuero.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יֵצֵ֤א דְבַר־ הַמַּלְכָּה֙ עַל־ כָּל־ הַנָּשִׁ֔ים לְהַבְז֥וֹת בַּעְלֵיהֶ֖ן בְּעֵינֵיהֶ֑ן בְּאָמְרָ֗ם הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֡וֹשׁ אָמַ֞ר לְהָבִ֨יא אֶת־ וַשְׁתִּ֧י הַמַּלְכָּ֛ה לְפָנָ֖יו וְלֹא־ בָֽאָה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yê·ṣê ḏə·ḇar- ham·mal·kāh ‘al- kāl- han·nā·šîm lə·haḇ·zō·wṯ ba‘·lê·hen bə·‘ê·nê·hen bə·’ā·mə·rām ham·me·leḵ ’ă·ḥaš·wê·rō·wōš ’ā·mar lə·hā·ḇî ’eṯ- waš·tî ham·mal·kāh lə·p̄ā·nāw wə·lō- ḇā·’āh
verses.literal: For the conduct of the queen will become known to all women causing them to despise . . . their husbands and say King Xerxes ordered Queen Vashti to be brought before him but she did not come
verses.literalPt: Pois o que fez a rainha tornar-se-á conhecido a todas as mulheres, induzindo-as a desprezarem seus maridos, ao ouvirem dizer: O rei Assuero mandou que a rainha Vasti fosse trazida à sua presença, porém ela não veio.

verses.original: וְֽהַיּ֨וֹם הַזֶּ֜ה תֹּאמַ֣רְנָה׀ שָׂר֣וֹת פָּֽרַס־ וּמָדַ֗י אֲשֶׁ֤ר שָֽׁמְעוּ֙ אֶת־ דְּבַ֣ר הַמַּלְכָּ֔ה לְכֹ֖ל שָׂרֵ֣י הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וּכְדַ֖י בִּזָּי֥וֹן וָקָֽצֶף׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hay·yō·wm haz·zeh tō·mar·nāh śā·rō·wṯ pā·ras- ū·mā·ḏay ’ă·šer šā·mə·‘ū ’eṯ- də·ḇar ham·mal·kāh lə·ḵōl śā·rê ham·me·leḵ ū·ḵə·ḏay biz·zā·yō·wn wā·qā·ṣep̄
verses.literal: This very day the noble women of Persia and Media who have heard about the queen’s conduct will say the same thing to all the king’s officials resulting in much contempt and wrath
verses.literalPt: Hoje mesmo, as princesas da Pérsia e da Média que ouviram o que fez a rainha dirão semelhantemente a todos os príncipes do rei. Assim, haverá muito desprezo e indignação.

verses.original: אִם־ עַל־ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ ט֗וֹב יֵצֵ֤א דְבַר־ מַלְכוּת֙ מִלְּפָנָ֔יו וְיִכָּתֵ֛ב בְּדָתֵ֥י פָֽרַס־ וּמָדַ֖י וְלֹ֣א יַעֲב֑וֹר אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־ תָב֜וֹא וַשְׁתִּ֗י לִפְנֵי֙ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֔וֹשׁ וּמַלְכוּתָהּ֙ יִתֵּ֣ן הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ לִרְעוּתָ֖הּ הַטּוֹבָ֥ה מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ‘al- ham·me·leḵ ṭō·wḇ yê·ṣê ḏə·ḇar- mal·ḵūṯ mil·lə·p̄ā·nāw wə·yik·kā·ṯêḇ bə·ḏā·ṯê p̄ā·ras- ū·mā·ḏay wə·lō ya·‘ă·ḇō·wr ’ă·šer lō- ṯā·ḇō·w waš·tî lip̄·nê ham·me·leḵ ’ă·ḥaš·wê·rō·wōš ū·mal·ḵū·ṯāh yit·tên ham·me·leḵ lir·‘ū·ṯāh haṭ·ṭō·w·ḇāh mim·men·nāh
verses.literal: So if . . . it pleases the king . . . let him issue a royal decree and let it be recorded in the laws of Persia and Media so that it cannot be repealed that Vashti shall never again enter the presence of King Xerxes and that her royal position shall be given . . . to a woman better than she
verses.literalPt: Se for do agrado do rei, saia da sua parte um edito real, e escreva-se entre as leis dos persas e dos medos, para que não seja revogado, que Vasti não entre mais na presença do rei Assuero; e dê o rei os seus direitos de rainha a outra que seja melhor do que ela.

verses.original: וְנִשְׁמַע֩ פִּתְגָ֨ם הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ אֲשֶֽׁר־ יַעֲשֶׂה֙ בְּכָל־ מַלְכוּת֔וֹ כִּ֥י רַבָּ֖ה הִ֑יא וְכָל־ הַנָּשִׁ֗ים יִתְּנ֤וּ יְקָר֙ לְבַעְלֵיהֶ֔ן לְמִגָּד֖וֹל וְעַד־ קָטָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·niš·ma‘ piṯ·ḡām ham·me·leḵ ’ă·šer- ya·‘ă·śeh bə·ḵāl mal·ḵū·ṯōw kî rab·bāh hî wə·ḵāl han·nā·šîm yit·tə·nū yə·qār lə·ḇa‘·lê·hen lə·mig·gā·ḏō·wl wə·‘aḏ- qā·ṭān
verses.literal: The edict the king issues will be heard throughout his vast . . . kingdom and so all women from the least to the greatest will honor . . . their husbands
verses.literalPt: Quando o decreto que o rei fizer for publicado por toda a parte do seu reino (pois é grande), todas as mulheres darão honra a seus maridos, tanto a grandes como a pequenos.

verses.original: וַיִּיטַב֙ הַדָּבָ֔ר בְּעֵינֵ֥י הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וְהַשָּׂרִ֑ים וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ כִּדְבַ֥ר מְמוּכָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yî·ṭaḇ had·dā·ḇār bə·‘ê·nê ham·me·leḵ wə·haś·śā·rîm way·ya·‘aś ham·me·leḵ kiḏ·ḇar mə·mū·ḵān
verses.literal: The king and his princes were pleased . . . with this counsel so the king did as Memucan advised
verses.literalPt: Pareceu bem o conselho ao rei e aos príncipes; e o rei fez conforme a palavra de Memucã,

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח סְפָרִים֙ אֶל־ כָּל־ מְדִינ֣וֹת הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אֶל־ מְדִינָ֤ה וּמְדִינָה֙ כִּכְתָבָ֔הּ וְאֶל־ עַ֥ם וָעָ֖ם כִּלְשׁוֹנ֑וֹ לִהְי֤וֹת כָּל־ אִישׁ֙ שֹׂרֵ֣ר בְּבֵית֔וֹ וּמְדַבֵּ֖ר כִּלְשׁ֥וֹן עַמּֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ sə·p̄ā·rîm ’el- kāl- mə·ḏî·nō·wṯ ham·me·leḵ ’el- mə·ḏî·nāh ū·mə·ḏî·nāh kiḵ·ṯā·ḇāh wə·’el- ‘am wā·‘ām kil·šō·w·nōw lih·yō·wṯ kāl- ’îš śō·rêr bə·ḇê·ṯōw ū·mə·ḏab·bêr kil·šō·wn ‘am·mōw
verses.literal: He sent letters to all the provinces of the kingdom to each province . . . in its own script and to each people . . . in their own language proclaiming - that every man should be master of his own household
verses.literalPt: pois enviou cartas a todas as províncias do rei, a cada província segundo o seu modo de escrever e a cada povo segundo a sua língua, para que todo homem governasse em sua casa e falasse segundo a língua do seu povo.
